name: example
_comment: Documentation of the rulepack format, not an enforced policy. One rule per tier: E1 (mechanical), F2 (metric-gateable), N1 (LLM-judge). Producer configs referenced here are for illustration only -- PCI never runs them; an external producer (ast-grep, a metrics tool) would be pointed at this file's paths in CI.

rules.description: Bare `except:` clauses are not allowed; catch a specific exception type.
rules.rationale: A bare except also swallows KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit, and hides bugs that should surface as a stack trace.

rules.description: Function cognitive complexity must stay under the pack's threshold.
rules.rationale: High cognitive complexity is the strongest predictor of defect density in the studies behind the metric; the threshold keeps a function reviewable in one pass.

rules.description: Names should describe what a value is or does, not how it is implemented.
rules.rationale: Mechanical checks can flag banned words, but judging whether a name is actually clear needs to read the surrounding code -- a judgment call, not a grep.
